Leader: Nearby allies gain a bonus while this unit is on the table.
Spectrum Mask: Once per turn, choose one mask power: laser burst, wide vision or short glide.
Strategist: Once per turn, one nearby ally may reroll one die.
Viper Mask: Once per turn, fire a corrosive shot that weakens a target's armor.
All-Terrain: Ignores movement penalties from rough terrain.
Demolitions: Its weapons gain a bonus against vehicles.
Backlash Mask: Once per turn, fire a kinetic blast that pushes a target back.
Strongman: Reduces the first damage taken each turn by 1.
Torch Mask: Once per turn, unleash a burst of flame against a nearby target.
Engineer: Once per turn, repair 1 health on a nearby vehicle.
Aura Mask: Once per turn, project an energy shield that absorbs part of the damage to a nearby ally.
Blaster Mask: Once per turn, fire a heat beam that ignores 1 point of armor.
Lifter Mask: Once per turn, an anti-gravity field lets a nearby ally ignore terrain penalties while moving.
Disguise: Once per turn, force an enemy to reroll one successful attack die against this unit.
Penetrator Mask: Once per turn, move through enemy units and obstacles.
Brawler: Gains a bonus when attacking enemies at close range.
Magna Beam Mask: Once per turn, fire a magnetic beam that pulls a nearby target closer.
Forger: Once per turn, cancel the bonus of one enemy Leader effect.
Buckshot Mask: Once per turn, fire a scatter shot that hits all units in a small area.
Saboteur: Once per turn, an enemy vehicle nearby loses 1 movement until the end of the turn.
Stiletto Mask: Once per turn, throw a razor-sharp blade at a nearby target.
Infiltrator: At deployment, this unit may be placed closer to the enemy.
Whip Mask: Once per turn, lash a nearby target to reduce its movement by 1 until the end of the turn.
Deep Freeze Mask: Once per turn, freeze a nearby target, reducing its movement to 1 until the end of the turn.
Hacker: Once per turn, cancel the "once per turn" effect of one nearby enemy unit.
Powerhouse Mask: Once per turn, gains a bonus to its next close-range attack.
Havoc: Once per turn, an enemy unit nearby must reroll one successful die.
Mudslinger Mask: Once per turn, fling mud at a nearby target to reduce its range by 1 until the end of the turn.
Jet Fighter: Once per turn, flies: ignores terrain and enemy units while moving.
Armored Shield: Ignores 1 damage from the first attack received each turn.
Radar Scanners: Once per turn, one nearby ally gains +1 range on its next attack.
Hypno-Headlights: Once per turn, a nearby enemy unit cannot choose this vehicle as the target of its next attack.
Battering Ram: Once per turn, when it moves into contact with an enemy unit, deals 1 damage to it.
Smokescreen: Once per turn, nearby allies count as in cover against the next attack that targets them.
Night Vision Scanner: Once per turn, a nearby ally ignores cover on its next attack.
Medic: Once per turn, heals 1 health on a nearby ally.
Streamer Mask: Once per turn, spray glue on a nearby target to reduce its movement by 1 until the end of the turn.
Gulliver Mask: Once per turn, enlarge or shrink a nearby unit: +1 armor or –1 armor until the end of the turn.
Hocus Pocus Mask: Once per turn, project a hologram decoy where this unit is looking: the next enemy attack aimed at this unit must target the decoy instead and is wasted.
